blind.description: An ornate Gothic-style reliquary casket resting atop a rectangular carved stone pedestal or altar. The stone base features decorative molding and relief-carved quatrefoil medallions on its sides. The reliquary itself is house-shaped with a gabled roof, constructed from an ornate golden metal framework lined with dark green enameled panels. It is encrusted with large, polished cabochon gems in alternating ruby red and emerald green set in arch-framed bezels, finished with small golden spherical finials along the roof ridge and gables. All geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with no hovering or disconnected artifacts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular gabled roof capped by a central ridge line of small golden spheres, with four jewel-set golden panels on each roof slope (alternating dark red and green oval gems), resting on the slightly protruding rectangular stone top and base plinth.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly chest height on the 5 ft 9 in figure), about 3.5 feet long, and about 2 feet wide.
